About Us:
YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.
Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.
We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View) APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.
What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:
YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.
Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:
• Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
• Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
• Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
• Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention
Who Thrives Here?
We hire sprinters, not coasters—people who:
• Choose growth over comfort
• Lead through challenges
• Are energized by high expectations
It’s not for everyone, and that’s intentional. If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.
As a Backend Engineer in the Data Feeds Team, You Will be Responsible for:
• Data Pipelines Maestro : You'll be responsible for developing, optimizing, and maintaining super-scalable data pipelines. Whether it's structured data flowing like a well-oiled stream or unstructured data that needs taming, you've got to make sure these pipelines are top-notch for seamless processing.
• Data Systems Guardian : Existing data systems and services. You bet you'll be the one maintaining and enhancing their stability, reliability, and ensuring high availability. Think of yourself as the shield that keeps our data world running smoothly.
• Data Architecture Builder : Team up with our amazing crew to construct and refine an expandable, high-performance data architecture. It's like building a digital skyscraper, but with data blocks!
• Data Services Provider : Partner with different teams across the board. Your mission is to serve up high-quality, rock-solid data services to all our internal users. They'll be relying on you like a lifeline for their data needs.
• Business-Aligned Data Designer : Get the hang of product and business requirements. Then, design and implement data functionalities that are not only useful but also come with super- intuitive data visualizations. Make data come alive!
• Third-Party Data Integrator : Oversee the integration and maintenance of collaborative data with our third-party clients. Solve their data mining and analytical headaches, and you'll be the hero of the data realm.
• Global Team Player : Work hand-in-glove with our US/SG/China teams. Be flexible with work hours as the data world never sleeps, and we need you to be on top of your game, always!
• Data Governance Enforcer : Enforce the best practices in data governance, security, and compliance. You're the gatekeeper of sensitive information, and you've got to keep it safe at all costs.
This is a fully-remote opportunity based in India. Standard work hours are from 8 am to 5 pm IST.

And we're just getting started. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who care as much as you do, we'd love for you to apply.

You’ll join Oyster as a Senior AI Solutions Engineer, reporting to the AI Director and partnering closely with functional leadership across Oyster.

Your mandate goes beyond automating individual tasks. You’ll help make Oyster’s business functions AI native, initially across areas such as People & Legal, Finance, and Operations. This means rethinking how people work with AI, where agents can take on operational work, and where human judgement creates the most value to build a more effective AI enabled organization.

You’ll be part of a connected group of Senior AI Solutions Engineers transforming different departments across Oyster. Together, you’ll establish shared standards, reuse successful approaches, and ensure Oyster’s AI transformation is coordinated rather than siloed.

This is a senior, hands on role. You’ll independently identify high value opportunities, decide where AI should and should not be used, and lead complex solutions from discovery through adoption and measurable business impact.

Successful candidates will be aligned to the business function where their experience, strengths, and interests can create the greatest impact, with the flexibility to support different functions as Oyster’s transformation priorities evolve.

 


CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Make business functions AI native

Reimagine how teams work with AI. Move teams from manually operating tools and workflows toward humans orchestrating AI powered ways of working, with human judgement where it matters.

Shape the AI roadmap

Partner with functional leaders to identify, prioritize, and frame high impact transformation opportunities.

Lead solutions from start to finish

Own complex initiatives from an ambiguous problem through design, build, deployment, adoption, and improvement.

Build best in class AI agents and solutions

Design, build, test, and continuously improve reliable AI agents, agentic workflows, automations, and integrations using LLMs, orchestration platforms, APIs, tools, and enterprise data sources.

Apply sound judgement

Balance value, feasibility, risk, data quality, maintainability, and human oversight. Recognize when AI is not the right solution.

Drive AI adoption and self sufficiency

Partner with functional leaders, managers, and champions to embed AI into everyday work. Help teams move beyond consuming AI outputs toward confidently creating reusable prompts, workflows, and AI powered ways of working.

Own solutions beyond launch

Measure adoption, quality, reliability, and business impact after release. Continuously improve solutions based on real usage and outcomes rather than treating launch as completion.

Connect the organization and raise capability

Build trust with functional leadership, share reusable patterns with AI Solutions Engineers supporting other departments, mentor colleagues, and help teams develop the skills and confidence to operate effectively in an AI enabled environment.

title: Manager, Delivery
description:
About LastPass
LastPass delivers Secure Access Essentials, helping individuals and organizations manage and protect access to AI, applications, and credentials straight from the browser. Trusted by more than 100,000 businesses and millions of users worldwide, LastPass blends strong security with everyday simplicity. From discovering unapproved AI and applications to reducing login friction and securing credentials across the business, LastPass delivers on its mission to give everyone seamless access to everything they need to work, move fast, and stay protected as their environments evolve.
Curious about our products? Visit our website and try it free!
We welcome new ideas, support your growth, and recognize your value, if this aligns with what you are looking for in your next career move, Join Us!
LastPass is looking for Manager, Delivery:
LastPass is looking for a Manager, Delivery to lead and develop a team of delivery professionals. In this management role, you will build delivery capability and drive outcomes across engineering — helping LastPass deliver on its mission to give everyone seamless access to everything they need to work, move fast, and stay protected.
About the team:
The Delivery team is a group of professionals who bring together product ownership, project delivery, planning, and stakeholder coordination across LastPass Engineering. The team is globally distributed, primarily located in Europe, and partners closely with engineering and product management to translate priorities into clear plans, manage dependencies, and drive predictable, well-coordinated outcomes across our products.
If you are passionate about complex problem solving and motivated by scale, then this is the role for you!
Who will you work with?
You will partner closely with Engineering leadership, Product Management, Design, and Security to maintain alignment and improve delivery outcomes across our products. You will also engage regularly with a broad range of stakeholders across the organisation, representing delivery priorities, facilitating cross-team coordination, and communicating plans and outcomes in a globally distributed, fast-paced engineering environment.
What are some of the exciting challenges you will be working on?
• Exploring, questioning, and creating new delivery practices for an increasingly AI-enabled environment.
• Applying AI-enabled approaches to improve planning, coordination, decision-making, and team effectiveness.
• Leading and developing the Delivery team, setting clear priorities and expectations while building accountability for consistent outcomes.
• Establishing structured, scalable delivery practices that improve predictability, transparency, and outcome validation.
• Bringing clarity to ambiguous and evolving situations so teams can define work, manage risks and dependencies, and maintain momentum.
• Coaching team members through regular feedback, performance management, and career development tailored to their roles and strengths.
• Identifying capability gaps and strengthening the team through hiring, development, and clear role expectations.
• Partnering with engineering and product leaders to align priorities, manage trade-offs, and improve delivery across teams.
What does it take to work at LastPass?
• Proven experience leading teams responsible for software product delivery, product ownership, project management, or related functions in a SaaS environment.
• Proven understanding of the software development lifecycle, from product discovery and requirements definition through engineering execution, validation, release, and outcome measurement.
• Proven experience managing complex, cross-functional initiatives with strong stakeholder communication and alignment across technical and business teams.
• Sufficient technical understanding to recognise system constraints, delivery risks, and trade-offs while partnering effectively with engineering teams.
• Proven experience establishing scalable delivery practices that improve predictability, transparency, risk management, and outcome validation.
• Recognised internally as someone who brings clarity, structure, and direction to ambiguous and evolving situations.
• Recognised for a continuous-improvement mindset and practical curiosity about using AI to improve planning, coordination, and delivery effectiveness.
• Recognised for building cohesive teams while acknowledging the distinct responsibilities and development needs of each team member.
It's great, but not required :
• Familiarity with AI-enabled planning or project management tools, and practical experience applying them to improve team workflows.
• Experience working in or alongside a security, identity, or enterprise SaaS product domain.
Why LastPass?
• The leader in secure access
• High-growth, collaborative environment with inclusive teams
• Remote-first culture
• Competitive compensation
• Flexible Paid Time Off policies , including but not limited to: Quarterly Self-Care Days (4 extra paid days off annually) and Volunteer Days
• Parental leave
• Comprehensive health coverage , including dependents
• Home office setup support
• LastPass Families free account for up to 5 members
• Continuous learning and development opportunities , including an annual learning stipend to invest in your growth
• Peer-to-peer recognition through Quantum Workplace
• Employee Assistance Program for well-being support
• Remote work stipend to support your home office needs
• Short-Term or Remote-Centric Work Arrangements for added flexibility

About Us

Axelera AI https://www.axelera.ai is not your regular deep-tech company. We are creating the next-generation AI platform to support anyone who wants to help advancing humanity and improve the world around us. 

In just five years, we have raised a total of $450 million and have built a world-class team of 250+ employees (including 60+ PhDs with more than 40,000 citations), both remotely from 21 different countries and with offices in Belgium, France, Switzerland, Italy, the UK, headquartered at the High Tech Campus in Eindhoven, Netherlands.

We have also launched our Metis™ AI Platform, which achieves a 3-5x increase in efficiency and performance, and have visibility into a strong business pipeline exceeding $100 million.

Our unwavering commitment to innovation has firmly established us as a global industry pioneer.

Are you up for the challenge?



Position Overview

As a Staff AI Application Engineer in the Model Enablement team (Application Software), you will build our model enablement platform and decide how each model runs across the Metis or Europa AIPU, the host CPU and the host's accelerators. How this work is split and scheduled determines most of the end-to-end performance a customer sees in the Voyager SDK.

The role combines architecture and hands-on work across the model frontend, the graph compiler, the runtime and the application pipeline. During model bring-up, you cover the frontend and graph side, and a device-side engineer covers the backend.

Our team uses AI coding agents in daily work, and you will use them to build, test and verify your own work. We also welcome experienced field application engineers, technical leads and engineering managers who want to return to hands-on engineering. Experience in planning, delegating and reviewing work transfers well to working with AI agents.



Key responsibilities:

 - Model enablement platform and agent harness: Build the platform that engineers and AI agents use to bring up models: reusable tools to partition, compile, run and profile; environments with access to real hardware; closed-loop runs that apply a change, measure it against the reference and repeat; and verification (differential testing, regression detection) integrated into CI.

 - Model ingestion: Own how a PyTorch or ONNX model is captured, analysed and split across the AIPU's matrix and RISC-V vector units, the host CPU and the host's accelerators (GPU, NPU, video decoder), with placement tags that users can read and override. Build this with the graph compiler team so it works for every model.

 - Heterogeneous execution: Extend that split to large models, cascades and multi-model pipelines, for example with expert offloading and caching across device and host memory. Agree the plan with the graph compiler team.

 - End-to-end performance: With the application team (pipeline builder) and the runtime team, bring each model to its best end-to-end performance: overlap of host and device work, zero-copy buffers, batching, multi-core scheduling, and models with several inputs. Profile device time, host time and data movement, and confirm each speedup in the full pipeline.

 - Critical models: Study the models that matter most to customers, on Metis today and on Europa, and turn each lesson into a platform improvement.



Qualifications:

Essential

 - 8+ years of engineering experience in systems, compilers, runtimes or performance, including system-level design ownership.

 - Hands-on experience with heterogeneous computing across CPU, GPU, DSP, NPU or FPGA, including reasoning about compute, memory bandwidth, latency and data movement.

 - Solid fundamentals in computer architecture, operating systems and parallel programming.

 - Familiarity with ML graph representations and compiler concepts: graph capture (torch.export, FX, ONNX), lowering, operator fusion, partitioning, memory planning.

 - Strong C++ and Python.

 - Daily use of AI coding agents on real engineering work, with the judgment to review and test their output.

Preferred

 - Hands-on experience with MLIR or another compiler framework (TVM, XLA, TorchInductor, IREE).

 - Experience with an inference runtime or execution engine (ONNX Runtime execution providers, a custom NPU or DSP runtime).

 - Experience with GPU compute (CUDA, OpenCL, Vulkan) or SIMD optimization on Arm or x86.

 - Experience with large-model execution techniques such as offloading, expert caching, speculative decoding, pipelining across devices.

 - Experience building agent environments, evaluation harnesses or verification frameworks (differential testing, regression detection), or MCP-based tooling.



Location

We offer a flexible working arrangement, with options to:

 - Work from one of our Axelera AI offices (Leuven in Belgium, Amsterdam and Eindhoven in the Netherlands, Zurich in Switzerland, Florence and Milan in Italy or Bristol in the United Kingdom) if you're already based in the vicinity.

 - Work fully remotely from any European country (incl. the UK) you are already in.

 - Relocate with us and work from Italy (Florence or Milan) or the Netherlands (Amsterdam or Eindhoven).

Axelera AI https://www.axelera.ai is not your regular deep-tech company. We are creating the next-generation AI platform to support anyone who wants to help advancing humanity and improve the world around us.

Position Overview

As a Senior AI Application Engineer in the Model Enablement team (Application Software), you will own LLM and VLM support on Metis and Europa AIPUs, from studying new models to shipping them in the Voyager SDK.

The role combines LLM/VLM knowledge with solid software engineering. Our team uses AI coding agents in daily work, and you will use them to build, test and verify your own work.

We also welcome experienced field application engineers, technical leads and engineering managers who want to return to hands-on engineering. Experience in planning, delegating and reviewing work transfers well to working with AI agents.



Key responsibilities:

 - LLM/VLM study: Study new LLM and VLM families and architectures (for example mixture-of-experts, small VLMs, new attention and decoding schemes). Prototype and profile them on Metis and Europa, and decide how they should run on our hardware.

 - Productization: Turn your results and our ML research group's results into supported Voyager SDK features, with stable APIs, tests, documentation and release gates.

 - Model-side contracts: For each LLM/VLM building block, own the PyTorch reference with quantization baked in, the weight mapping, and one contract that lists every input, output, weight and persistent state (such as a paged KV cache), and hand that contract to the compiler team. The runtime and tests use the same definition.

 - Pipeline integration: Bring LLM and VLM serving into the Voyager SDK pipeline builder: prefill and decode, KV-cache management, streaming text output and multimodal inputs.

 - Quality: With the regression and quantization owners, measure accuracy against the floating-point reference, and close or explain each gap.

 - LLM/VLM bring-up platform: Extend the model enablement platform for LLM and VLM bring-up: environments with access to the compiler, runtime and real hardware (for example through MCP tools), closed-loop runs that apply a change, measure accuracy and speed against the reference and repeat, and evaluations that score each run.

 - GenAI direction: Recommend what the Voyager SDK needs for GenAI, agents and speech on edge devices, and which model zoo demos show it best.
   
   

Qualifications:

Essential

 - 5+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years on ML inference, ML systems or ML tooling.

 - Solid understanding of transformer inference: attention variants, KV caching, prefill versus decode, sampling, tokenization, and how a VLM joins a vision encoder to a language model.

 - Working knowledge of LLM quantization (weight-only and weight-activation schemes, calibration, outlier handling), and the ability to tell a quantization loss from an implementation bug.

 - Strong Python and PyTorch, and experience shipping production-quality software.

 - Daily use of AI coding agents on real codebases, with good judgment about when to verify or reject their output.

 - Ability to turn research code and hardware constraints into a practical design.

Preferred

 - Experience with inference engines or serving stacks (for example llama.cpp, vLLM, ONNX Runtime GenAI, ExecuTorch).

 - Experience with kernel development or a tensor compiler (for example Triton, TVM or MLIR), or with profiling models on accelerator hardware.

 - Experience with speech (ASR, TTS) or agentic applications on embedded devices.

 - Experience building evaluation or testing harnesses for ML systems or AI agents, or tool-calling agents (for example MCP servers).

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.
Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.
Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.
Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.
Our Team Members:
We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!
We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.
Your Role:
Your job is to build Alpaca's algo trading platform to satisfy our users who expect high quality and performance from their brokerage service. This opportunity is similar to joining AWS or Heroku in their early days, designing and architecting our platform by wearing many different hats in our small team. As an experienced engineer, you will write tons of code and make critical decisions about delivering the best experience to our customers. This certainly requires deep knowledge in both frontend and backend, databases and distributed systems, as well as broad experience from low to high level in CPU-level hardware for high throughput, robust concurrency system design, abstract distributed system architecture for high availability and object-oriented data modeling with long term growth in mind. Joining an early stage startup, the payoff to this highly demanding environment will be worth the effort.
You must have previous software engineering experience with trading or exchange systems (OMS, EMS, exchanges, market making, algorithmic trading, quant trading).

• Strong, experienced software engineer with lead experience is preferred
• Coding skills in both low and high level languages around C/C++, Go, Zig, Rust, Java, Scala, Python
• Low latency and high throughput optimization
• Experience with messaging queues and message brokers
• Analytical data-oriented mindset and skills
• Knowledge of algorithms, distributed systems, scalability, high availability, databases, low latency systems and concurrency control
• System design skills with object-oriented data modeling, service-oriented architectures, system abstraction
• Experience with the development and implementation of Order Management systems (OMS) and Risk Management systems (RMS)
Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):
• Algo trading experience (either professional or personal)
• FIX protocol knowledge
• Experience with observability, tracing, continuous profiling and benchmarking
• Financial market (exchange, broker-dealers, clearing, etc.) knowledge
• Experience with financial ledgers
• Statistical and quantitative analysis skills
• Experience with major cloud platforms (we primarily use GCP)
• Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
How We Take Care of You:
• Competitive Salary & Stock Options
• Health Benefits
• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card
Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.
